simple.meaning: רְוָחָה (rᵉvâchâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “relief.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 8:11. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רְוָחָה (H7309) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: רְוָחָה (rᵉvâchâh) / H7309 is traced through Exodus 8:11, Lamentations 3:56 with generated occurrence evidence.
